description: Prepares an ETH-funded spot grid or infinity grid bot on a token from list_bot_presets, sized by budget_usd, and returns a signing link on nlyra.xyz (valid 30 min) — plus, when a wallet is given, the unsigned transaction. The bot runs in The Desk's escrow contract under the user's own wallet; only that wallet can stop it and withdraw. Bots are refused on tokens our risk gate blocks.

budget_usd.description: how many dollars of ETH to put in the bot

wallet.description: the wallet that will sign; with it you also get the raw transaction

name: prepare_bot
title: Prepare a trading bot (non-custodial)
